newsitem.title: USA: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.8 Nov 8 wk.
newsitem.headline: ECRI future U.S. inflation gauge 104.8 Nov 8 wk.

text.p: The Economic Cycle Research Institute (ECRI) weekly future inflation gauge (FIG) rose slightly to 104.8 in the week ended November 8 from a revised 104.7 in the previous week, ECRI said.
Faster growth in real estate loans and a narrower yield spread between 10-year Treasury notes and three-month Treasury bills help push the index up, ECRI said.
"The FIG has exhibited very little movement in either direction since last spring ... suggesting inflation will remain in the current range for the next few months," it said.
